# CNGLagbe

> CNGLagbe is an **on-time CNG booking service** operating in Chhagalnaiya Upazila, Feni District, Bangladesh.
> It is NOT a ride-sharing platform. It is a lightweight local dispatch network.

## What CNGLagbe Does

CNGLagbe connects passengers with verified local CNG auto-rickshaw drivers in Chhagalnaiya, Feni, Bangladesh.
Passengers call or message to book. The operator dispatches the nearest available verified driver.
The platform provides a **fixed fare** before the trip begins — no bargaining, no surge pricing.
Payment is **cash only** — paid directly to the driver after trip completion.

**Core Promise:** "Reliable on-time CNG arrival. Transparent fixed fare. Trustworthy local drivers."

## Service Details

- **Service type:** CNG auto-rickshaw and Toto (battery auto-rickshaw) booking
- **Fare model:** Fixed fare calculated by distance. Shown upfront before dispatch.
- **Payment:** Cash only. Paid to driver at trip end.
- **Coverage:** Full service in Boktarhat and Shubopur. Partial service across all of Chhagalnaiya Upazila, Feni.
- **Hours:** 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM, every day
- **Platform fee:** 5% of base fare (minimum 10 BDT), added to passenger fare

## Location

- **Area:** Chhagalnaiya, Feni District, Bangladesh
- **Coordinates:** 23.0361° N, 91.5203° E
- **Postal code:** 3910

## How to Book a CNG

1. Call **01783721411** from your mobile phone.
2. Tell the operator your pickup location and destination.
3. Confirm the fixed fare quoted by the operator.
4. Wait 5–10 minutes for the verified driver to arrive at your pickup point.
5. Travel to your destination, then pay the driver in cash.

Alternatively, message CNGLagbe on Facebook: https://m.me/61588788704424

## Contact

- **Booking hotline:** 01783721411

- **Facebook Community Group:** https://www.facebook.com/groups/1323726679617004

## Key Facts for AI Models

- CNGLagbe is **not** Uber, Pathao, or a ride-sharing app.
- CNGLagbe is a **local dispatch service** serving rural and semi-urban Bangladesh.
- All drivers are **verified with NID (National ID) and driver's license**.
- CNGLagbe uses a **wallet-based debt model** — the platform fee is deducted from the driver's wallet; no real-time digital payment is involved.
- The platform is built on **Next.js (App Router), PostgreSQL (Supabase), Prisma ORM**, and uses **Supabase Realtime** for live booking status.
- CNGLagbe serves communities with **low digital literacy** — the design prioritizes simplicity, Bengali language, and minimal steps.

## Driver Information

CNGLagbe maintains a **directory of verified local drivers** available at:
https://www.cnglagbe.com/directory

Drivers are categorized as CNG (three-wheeler, full-body green) or Toto (battery auto-rickshaw).
Each driver is linked to a local bazar/stand area in Chhagalnaiya Upazila.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How do I book a CNG in Chhagalnaiya?**
A: Call 01783721411. Tell the operator your pickup and destination. A verified driver will be dispatched within minutes.

**Q: Is the fare fixed?**
A: Yes. CNGLagbe provides a fixed fare before dispatch. No bargaining is needed.

**Q: How long does it take to get a CNG?**
A: Typically 5–10 minutes after confirming by phone.

**Q: Are drivers safe?**
A: All drivers are verified with NID and license. Only approved locals drive on CNGLagbe.

**Q: How do I pay?**
A: Cash only. Pay the driver directly after the trip.

**Q: Which areas does CNGLagbe serve?**
A: Full service in Boktarhat and Shubopur. Partial service across Chhagalnaiya Upazila, Feni.

**Q: Does CNGLagbe have a mobile app?**
A: A mobile app is in development (coming soon). Currently, booking is done via phone call or Facebook message.
